title: task list human view: embedded Backlog frontmatter in description renders indistinguishably from live record fields
description:
quest-web filed this during restart-prep 2026-09-28 (cross-session finding, not urgent, no reply expected): the human view of quest task list prints multi-line description values unindented, and Backlog-migrated records embed their original Backlog.md file, frontmatter included, inside description - so the render contains lines indistinguishable from live record fields.

Their measurement on quest 0.11.0: .quest/tasks/QWEB-2.json live status is Done, but its description contains "status: To Do" from the backlog era; quest task list | grep -c "status:" returns 82 for a 64-task tracker (64 live plus 18 embedded frontmatter blocks, including 4 subtask ids that exist only as embedded text). It nearly produced a wrong whole-population tracker count during a fleet status sweep.

Reproduced here, worse in absolute terms: quest task list --json | jq ".data | length" gives 405 records while quest task list | grep -cE "[[:space:]]*status:" gives 641. jq -r .description .quest/tasks/QCLI-1.json shows the embedded Backlog frontmatter (id, title, status, assignee, created_date...).

The fix approach is left to this repository: the human renderer quoting, indenting, or otherwise delimiting description content so embedded lines cannot read as record fields. Not urgent; rank with the orchestrator.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The human view of quest task list renders description content so a reader cannot mistake embedded lines for live record fields: on the same repro quest-web used, the json count versus the grep -cE status count no longer diverges, or the render visibly delimits description content
A regression test holds a fixture record whose description embeds Backlog frontmatter and asserts the human render marks it as description content

plan: Reproduce: a record whose description embeds Backlog frontmatter, rendered in the human task list
Delimit multi-line string values in renderHumanPayload so embedded lines cannot read as fields
Regression test: the fixture's embedded frontmatter is marked as description content
run bun run check, review, land
implementationNotes:
THE REPRO, MEASURED on the dev build (quest 0.13.0, 2026-10-11) with a fixture whose description embeds Backlog frontmatter: `quest task list --json` .data length = 1, while `quest task list | grep -cE "[[:space:]]*status:"` = 2. The extra line is the embedded `status: To Do`, and the live field is `status: Done`.

WHICH AC0 ARM APPLIES: the SECOND. The counts do NOT converge after the fix and cannot: the grep is UNANCHORED (`[[:space:]]*status:` matches `status:` anywhere in a line, whether or not it is indented), so any rendering that preserves the description's characters keeps the extra line, and removing it would mean mangling the content. What the fix changes is that the embedded line is now VISIBLY DELIMITED: it renders under `description:` prefixed with the block marker `| `, so a reader sees `    | status: To Do` beside the record's own `  status: Done` and cannot mistake the former for a field. That is AC0's "or the render visibly delimits description content".

THE FIX: renderHumanPayload (src/cli/render.ts) delimited a MULTI-LINE string value -- under a key, or as an array item, the value renders as a header line followed by each line prefixed `| ` at the value indentation. A SINGLE-LINE string is unchanged, so no other render churns (bun run check is green with no other golden moved).

AC1: test/qcli409-description-delimiting.test.ts builds the fixture, moves the record to Done, and asserts the render marks the embedded frontmatter (`| status: To Do`, `| id: QWEB-9`) while no UNMARKED `status: To Do` line survives, and that a single-line value (the title) is NOT delimited.
finalSummary: QCLI-409: the human task list now delimits multi-line description content. renderHumanPayload renders a multi-line string value as a header plus each line prefixed `| `, so Backlog-migrated frontmatter embedded in a description (including its `status: To Do`) can no longer read as a live record field. AC0's second arm applies and is recorded: the json-vs-grep counts cannot converge because the grep is unanchored, but the embedded line is now visibly marked as description content. Single-line values are unchanged. Regression test + bun run check green. Delivered on branch fix/QCLI-409-description-delimiting, record in the same PR.
